
# InfraPulse

## Company Summary

InfraPulse Technologies Private Limited is a software development company established in 2014, based in Mayur Vihar, Delhi, India.

InfraPulse builds software and digital solutions for businesses, including web applications, mobile apps, ERP, CRM, UI/UX, APIs, cloud and DevOps, SEO, and ongoing maintenance and support.

## Official Company Details

- Legal Name: INFRAPULSE TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED
- Established: 2014
- Location: Mayur Vihar, Delhi, India - 110091
- Website: https://infrapulsetech.com
- Email: info@infrapulsetech.com
- Hotline: +91 83838 94651

## Services

### Website Development

Modern, responsive, and high-performance websites and web applications.

### Mobile App Development

Native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.

### Custom ERP Development

Tailored ERP systems to streamline business operations and workflows.

### CRM Development

Customer relationship management solutions for sales and customer operations.

### UI/UX Design

User-centered design for intuitive digital experiences and interfaces.

### API Development

Scalable REST and GraphQL APIs for system integrations.

### SEO Services

Search engine optimization, including technical audits, on-page optimization, keyword research, content strategy, and performance tracking.

### Cloud & DevOps

Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps automation using AWS and Azure.

### Maintenance & Support

Ongoing software maintenance, updates, security patches, performance monitoring, and feature enhancements.

## Products

### OZii ERP

Business software platform for HRMS, payroll, accounts, and operations.

### BillFlow 360

Invoice dashboard with revenue analytics, expenditure management, and P&L insights.
